name: Neon Ladder Scoreboard
description: An underground CTF scoreboard has gone quiet between rounds. Recover the protected final-round flag from the service running on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the final-round flag
tasks.description: The Neon Ladder underground CTF scoreboard is hiding its final-round flag. Find and recover it from the service on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Take inventory of reachable services and pay attention to how they respond before you authenticate.
Scoreboard operators often choose passwords connected to the venue or its purpose. Try a small set of plausible guesses.
After logging in to the Redis service, read the final arena record.
